hash_policy.canonical_lf_definition: Read exact bytes and replace each CRLF byte pair (0D 0A) with LF (0A). Preserve all other bytes, including any BOM; do not reserialize JSON for hashing.
hash_policy.review_evidence_sha256: Per-path policy in review_evidence_hash_policy: canonical LF for retained text, raw bytes for images/video.
hash_policy.previous_catalog_sha256: Historical raw-byte hash copied from the preceding freeze.
hash_policy.embedded_provenance: Unchanged older provenance files retain raw-byte hashes recorded at their original import or metadata update. Current verification uses this freeze canonical-LF text maps. The three changed reports explicitly identify their current manifest hash policy and separately retain the prior raw hash. New NE and Raider reports retain importer-time raw hashes; current freeze maps remain canonical-LF authority. Historical source-generation records and prompt hashes are never silently rewritten.
hash_policy.submitted_prompts: Historical prompt/source-generation records are untouched; their submitted-prompt hashes describe exact original bytes. Current canonical hashes for new retained prompt/record files are separately listed in source_provenance_text_sha256.
